# Spec test vectors

`cluster_hashing.json` is copied unmodified from
[ObolNetwork/distributed-validator-specs](https://github.com/ObolNetwork/distributed-validator-specs)
`test_vectors/cluster_hashing.json` at commit
`406c832a94d52dc326439514495dd25fb0722db7`. That repository is MIT licensed
(Copyright (c) 2025 Obol Labs, Inc.), which allows copying it here.

It holds config, definition and lock hash cases for v1.10.0 cluster files
generated by Charon. `test/verification/specVectors.spec.ts` runs every case. To
update, copy the file from a newer specs commit and change the commit above.
